name: 18039-longprompt-mimov2flash-8gpu
model: XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2-Flash. NOT SUBSTITUTABLE. 313.1 GB of safetensors, ungated, not in the local HF cache.
parallelism: TP=8 with DP-attention 2: attention at TP=4 in each of two groups, MoE over all 8 ranks; EP off, PP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: MiMoV2FlashForCausalLM, ~307 B parameters with ~14 B active per token, fp8 e4m3 with dynamic activation scales and a bf16 KV cache. Further detail is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=224, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 896 requests with a 5400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no prefix sharing: prompts around 4000 tokens (stdev 512, clipped to [3072, 5120]) and a FIXED 8000 output tokens, with `ignore_eos: true`, `temperature: 0.0` and seed 42, so every request executes exactly 8000 decode steps.
purpose: A long-form report writer turning 4,000-token briefs into 8,000-token drafts for 224 concurrent users on eight GPUs.
launch:
# sglang at commit 38d275a9fd7c42353839b88ce83359444fb3cb6c (v0.5.8 era), eight H100s of one
# node serving MiMo-V2-Flash. Anything not named here is a stock default of the pinned commit.

model-path: XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2-Flash

tp-size: 8

# Two DP-attention groups: attention runs at TP 4 inside each, the MoE keeps all eight ranks.
# This checkpoint's FP8 attention block scales load at attention TP 4 (its own SGLang layout), not at 8.
dp-size: 2
enable-dp-attention: true

# The checkpoint ships an auto_map pointing at its own modelling code; without this the server
# will not start.
trust-remote-code: true

# Written out although it is also the resolved default here: an omitted key resolves through a
# literal architecture list, and a miss there does not fail loudly, it runs another attention
# implementation. Confirm it from the launch log.
attention-backend: fa3

page-size: 64

# Pinned, not derived. If the server will not start, lower it here in steps of 0.02 -- not
# --disable-cuda-graph, which changes the per-step cost this setup reads.
mem-fraction-static: 0.85

# The workload never exceeds 5120 + 8000 tokens; the checkpoint declares 262144.
context-length: 16384
